sections.advice: Arequipa → Patapampa Pass climbs about 4910 m in 96 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Patapampa Pass → Chivay drops about 4910 m over 14 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Chivay → Cruz del Condor is 41 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Cruz del Condor → Cabanaconde is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Arequipa → Patapampa Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 154 km. 4910 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Colca Canyon Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4910 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Colca Canyon Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 16 km this is Colca Canyon Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

colca-canyon-route.story: A one-way ride of 258 km, Arequipa to Cabanaconde - roughly 3 h 33 in the saddle. The stops in between: Patapampa Pass, Chivay and Cruz del Condor. The highest point is about 4,900 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 42 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-sairam-ugam-state-national-nature.story: On the way it passes Sairam-Ugam State National Nature Park - B, Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part, The Chatkal State Biosphere Nature Reserve and back through Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part. The highest point is about 2,700 m. It crosses Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Jisho-ji → Nara Palace Site
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-jisho-ji-pilgrimage-routes-kumano.story: From Kamigyō-ku it runs 331 km to Kamigyō-ku; allow about 5 h 42 of riding. It goes by way of Nara Palace Site, Kengoshizuka Mounded Tomb, Yoshino and Ômine - Ôminesan-ji and Pilgrimage Routes - Kumano Sankeimichi - K. The highest point is about 800 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
